treatment: For compatibility with host HTML instrumentation, original head and body markup are placed inside an explicit doctype/html/head/body document and the exact original inline JavaScript is served externally. No scientific data, algorithm, controls, field rendering or playback logic changed. The original HTML remains unchanged and is offered as a download.
reason: The inline version produced a browser SyntaxError and unexpected extra script elements in this host. Externalizing the exact script prevents its HTML-looking SVG literals from being treated as document markup during HTML instrumentation.

managed_preview_browser.scope: Render and running-playback verification. Dedicated field/pause control checks are recorded separately by the site owner.
